<local-command-stdout>## PR Self-Check Result

### Fix
None.

### Note
None.

### Unverifiable
- [Grounded] The verification item at line 34 ("Clause mapping built against `main`, covering the 37 rule bullets... none dropped or duplicated") rests on `ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md`, which is gitignored and outside the repo — a fresh clone cannot re-run this check. It exists on this machine (same author host); I read it and spot-checked its Decidable and Grounded rows against the merge-base text, and they matched, but did not walk all 37 rows, so full coverage is unconfirmed from repo state alone.

### Property walk
- Decidable: the body itself follows the altitude rule it introduces — each `Key changes` bullet carries the change at the top level with rationale nested beneath.
- Grounded: every checkbox item carries a reproducible check (diff exit codes, `grep -c` counts, `git ls-tree`), and the two edge-case Grounded rules named in "Where a reformat can change a rule" were independently diffed against the merge base and confirmed unchanged in requirement.
- Necessary: no diff paraphrase; each bullet states a decision and its "why," not a restatement of the changed lines.
- Scoped: all three touched files (`git-workflow/SKILL.md`, `pr-guidelines.md`, `pr-selfcheck/SKILL.md`) serve the stated intent; the severity-tier collapse (three tiers → two) is explained as a direct consequence of removing the bullet-count escalation rule, not an unexplained addition.
- Conformant: title is a one-line summary, no auto-close keywords, checkboxes used only for verification items, no hard-wrap violations found in the body.

### Verdict
PASS

Note: PR #367 is already merged (squash commit `9bbe3c0` on `main`), so this is a retrospective self-check rather than a pre-merge gate. Verification was done against the pre-merge base commit `b9256e4` (parent of the squash merge) rather than current `main`, since `main` already contains this PR's changes.

Independently confirmed facts used above:
- `claude/skills/git-workflow/pr-guidelines.md` at `b9256e4` has exactly 45 top-level `- ` bullets, and it is the largest such flat list among the 17 markdown files under `claude/rules/` and `claude/skills/` (next largest: 25).
- The property-definition list (lines 17-29) and the `## PR Body Template (fallback)` block are byte-identical between `b9256e4` and the merged `9bbe3c0`.
- No rule text about counting bullets remains under `Decidable`; the surviving bullet-count language ("distinct decision," "do not restate") sits only under `Necessary`.</local-command-stdout>
